dedupe_keys.name: maintal blackout simulation model and input data

description: Alpha IC and 4wardEnergyResearch publish inputs and results for blackout simulations in Maintal, Germany. Zenodo lists a public data dictionary and a large ZIP under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The dictionary names normal and blackout household loads, photovoltaic generation, device-activation probabilities, electric-vehicle state and travel, hot-water use, and two storage capacities of 229.5 and 382.5 kWh. Electrical profiles use 15-minute steps, while some household variables use one-minute steps. The package can support household energy resilience and storage-sufficiency simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these Maintal scenarios. A limitation is that the archive is about 2.7 GB and was not downloaded, so the number of households, data completeness and results are unverified. The dictionary repeats a result filename for both storage sizes, requiring file-level checking before comparison. No blackout simulation was run.
